system.boundary: Build a closed-loop electrohydraulic scissor lift that raises, holds, and returns a payload platform using one double-acting hydraulic actuator.
engineering_objects: Build a closed-loop electrohydraulic scissor lift that raises, holds, and returns a payload platform using one double-acting hydraulic actuator.
A finite pressure supply and return reservoir must feed a physically metered four-way valve.

A finite electromechanical actuator must move the valve element, the valve must route real fluid into and out of both cylinder chambers, and the cylinder must drive a scissor linkage carrying the platform.
physical_paths: A finite pressure supply and return reservoir must feed a physically metered four-way valve.
Measured cylinder extension must close the positioning loop through unrestricted control logic to the real valve actuator on this same hydraulic power path.

Across the declared target, timing, and supply-pressure ranges, the controller must follow the full positioning cycle without sustained oscillation, keep cylinder and valve motion bounded, and preserve tracking through the pressure change.
